title: usb: Dissect FreeBSD USB packets
description:
For control transfers, the Setup and Data stages are delivered as
separate frames on FreeBSD. To properly dissect a control transfer, we
concatenate all related frames into a single buffer because the USB
dissector may need to reference data across both stages. To simplify
this handling, we create a new tvbuff containing the concatenated packet
data.

For other transfer types, decoding each data frame independently is
sufficient.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)

notes.body: changed title from usb: Dissect USB packets on FreeBSD. to usb: Dissect FreeBSD USB packets
Title changed because this code runs on *all* OSes, not just FreeBSD; what it means is that it makes Wireshark dissect USB packets *from* FreeBSD.
Oh ok. Thanks for your comment:)

> Presumably !25075, that being their previous merge request.

That one adds a case for FreeBSD USB packets to the switch statement in `dissect_freebsd_usb()`, to make the FreeBSD USB packet code path more like that for other USB packet formats.
